title: Campaign Runway
origin: Criteo-calibrated response cells + synthetic retail CRM
arrival_extension: Days 29-30 continue the mean daily arrival weight from source days 22-28.
group_definition: Primary shopping mission; no outcome or response-time field defines membership.
assumptions: Anonymous source cells supply response heterogeneity, not recovered retail meanings.
Versioned soft allocation gives every shopping mission a mix of source profiles.
Propensity rank and a discovery-context timing rank connect aggregate source cells; no identities are joined.
Prior purchase history is retailer-wide; campaign conversion is a benchmark response to the promoted collection.
Weekly audience turnover is weighted by synthetic order history and promotion affinity.
New arrivals enter the reachable audience; they may already have purchased from the retailer.
Timing and contact coverage include a declared retail decision-clock and familiarity layer; raw source histories are retained. These are separable scenario inputs; individual outcomes are seeded.
